info.title: ObserveCraft API
info.description: API consumed by the ObserveCraft web app.

post.summary: Endpoints whose p95 latency or error rate rose versus the previous period of equal length.
Database calls made by a service, grouped by system, database and statement.
Services this one calls (downstream) and services calling it (upstream).
Versions of a service seen in the range, newest first.
`deployment.environment` values seen in the range (for env selectors).
Error spans grouped by service, resource, exception type and message.
Rule-based recommendations computed from spans: N+1 call patterns, error-prone and slow endpoints.
Endpoints (span names of entry spans) with throughput, errors, latency and time share.
Header facts, health and the requests/errors/latency series for one service.
Every service seen in the range: instrumented (entry spans) and inferred (peers of client spans).
Service entry spans matching the query, newest first (keyset-paginated).

get.summary: All spans of one trace (waterfall / flame graph).

post.summary: Presses a button: runs its workflow with the app's values. Read the run with `get_workflow_run`.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Matches actor, action, target or detail.

get.summary: What the sign-in page should offer (public).

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: Organization id; defaults to the install's organization.

post.summary:
Accepts an invite / reset link and signs in (MFA still applies if enabled). A new account sets its
password here; an existing account joins the org by confirming its current password.
Signs in to the requested org, else the last one used, else the account's first organization.
Ends this browser session.

303.description: Signed in; redirect to the app

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: App path to return to after sign-in.

post.summary: Assertion Consumer Service: the IdP POSTs the signed response here.

303.description: Signed in; redirect to the app

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: App path to return to after sign-in.

post.summary:
"Sign in with your organization": picks the SSO login for an email address. The answer doesn't
depend on whether the account exists (the install's org is used when the email is unknown), so it
can't be used to probe for users.

get.summary: Repositories that reported pipeline runs in the last 30 days.

post.summary: Soft delete (restorable from the Deleted list).

get.summary: Dashboards this user opened most recently.

post.summary: Dashboards matching a preset list, custom list, team and title/author text; starred first.

get.summary: Opens a dashboard: also records the view (recently viewed, popularity).

post.summary: Airflow DAGs and Spark applications that reported in the range, with their runs.
An instance's current values and its connections, throughput, cache hit ratio, replication lag and size over the range.
Database instances that reported in the last minutes of the range, with their current values.
How many issues have logs (or spans) with each service, env and version.
Issues from the organization's error logs and APM error spans in the range (first and last seen within it).
One issue in the range: its histogram, the tags of its logs (or spans) and its saved state.
One log (or span) of the issue (the `index`-th newest or oldest in range), and how many there are.
Sets an issue's status (reviewed, ignored, resolved, back for review) and/or its assignee.
Tag keys of the matching events, most common first: the facets "+ Add" offers.
Search events, newest first, with facet counts over the same filter.

Triage Inbox: the range's warning and error events correlated into work items, one per affected
object (the Agent's aggregation key) or, without one, per source and title.

get.summary: Every flag of the org with its state per environment, and the environments.

post.summary: Creates a flag, off in every environment and serving its default variant there.

delete.summary: Deletes an environment and every flag's configuration in it.

get.summary: Global Flag History: changes across every flag, newest first.

put.summary:
Changes a flag's details and variants (its key stays). Environments that serve a removed
variant must be changed first.

Sets a flag's configuration in one environment: on or off, targeting rules, the default and
a progressive rollout.

post.summary: GPUs that reported in the last minutes of the range, with their current values.
Utilization, memory, temperature and power over the range, for the GPUs matching the query, per group.
Containers of the pods on this host, by memory.
Pods the Kubernetes collector reports on this host (its node).
Processes seen in the last 10 minutes, by CPU.
Fills a postmortem from the incident: properties, impact, root cause, timeline and follow-ups. Editable afterwards.
The diagram of one provider's resources, grouped, with the requested overlay.
Creates a policy.

get.summary: The attributes policies can check, per resource type in the catalog.

post.summary: What a policy being edited would score on the current catalog.

Policies with their compliance (counting only resources matching the page's filters), the
templates with a preview score, and the filters' values.

get.summary: A policy with its score over time and its noncompliant resources.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The page's filters, as in the list.

delete.summary: Deletes a policy and its history.

get.summary: Every key of the organization, revoked ones included (with `revokedAt`), newest first.

delete.summary:
Permanently deletes an organization: its users, content and settings now, its telemetry in the
background. Accounts that belong to other organizations keep those memberships.

patch.summary: Renames, suspends or reactivates an organization. Suspension ends its sessions and rejects its keys.
Sets what an org may configure. Lowering a ceiling also lowers settings above it.

post.summary: Starts a search over archived logs; poll it with GET /api/v1/logs/archive-searches/{id}.

delete.summary: Cancels a running search, or deletes a finished one with its results.

post.summary: Creates an archive after proving the bucket is writable.
Checks that the bucket can be written, read and deleted from with these credentials.

delete.summary: Stops archiving and forgets the archive; files already in the bucket are left there.

post.summary: Archives every pending closed hour now (instead of waiting for the background job).
Top values per facet. Each facet ignores its own filter so unchecked values keep their counts.
The tags and attributes of the matching logs (from the newest 10,000), to add as facets.
Status-stacked log counts over time.

delete.summary: Stops indexing into it; its logs stay searchable (`index:<name>`) until they expire.

post.summary: Error outliers: services whose share of errors far exceeds their share of traffic.

get.summary: Streams `batch` events (JSON `LiveTailBatch`) every 250 ms.

200.description: text/event-stream of `batch` events carrying LiveTailBatch JSON

put.summary: Changes the query, aggregation or group-bys; the name stays.

delete.summary: Stops computing it; points already written stay until they expire.

post.summary: The matching logs grouped by pattern (Group into Patterns), from the newest 10,000 of them.

get.summary: Integration pipelines (from integrations-core) and whether each is installed.

post.summary: Installs an integration's pipeline (read-only, at the end of the list).
Parses sample values with grok rules (the grok parser editor's live preview).
Runs processors (and optionally a filter) on a sample log and returns the processed log.

patch.summary: Enables or disables a pipeline (integration pipelines too).

post.summary: Loads archived logs back into ClickHouse; search them in the Log Explorer with `index:rehydrated`.

Checks a query and counts the logs of the last hour it matches. Admins read every log, so the
count is the query's alone.

put.summary: Replaces the name, description, query and assignments.

post.summary: Newest-first page of logs matching the query.
Adds an attribute (or brings back a default the org removed, with this definition).

delete.summary: Drops the org's changes: the list is the defaults again.

put.summary: Changes the type, description, aliases or source handling; the path stays.

delete.summary: Removes an attribute; a default is hidden until the list is reset. Logs already stored keep their attributes.

post.summary: Autocomplete for the query bar: keys (`service:`) and `key:value` pairs with counts.
The most frequent values of a key among the matching logs (dashboard toplists and sunbursts).
Ends every session of the current account (in every organization), including this one.
Starts enrollment: a new secret that becomes active once confirmed with a code.

get.summary: The organizations this account belongs to (active memberships in active orgs).

post.summary: Changes the password and signs out every other session.

Moves this browser session to another of the account's organizations (a new session token is issued).
Sessions started with single sign-on are bound to that organization; an org that requires SSO can
only be entered through its identity provider (admins excepted).

get.summary: Metrics reported in the last day plus the span-derived `trace.*` metrics.

post.summary: Metrics by cardinality: the distinct series each reported in the range.

Mute (creates a downtime per monitor), unmute (cancels the monitor's downtimes), resolve (sets
every triggered group back to OK until the next evaluation says otherwise) or delete.
Backtests a monitor definition: how its value and status would have evolved over `range`.
Sends one transition's message to its recipients now, marked as a test.

DNS traffic between clients and the DNS servers they query (Network Analytics' DNS view): the
Agent's DNS stats per connection, domain and query type.

Flows between the client and server groups in the range, biggest first, with the summary
series and the facets.
Notebooks of a list (mine, team, recents, favorites, all, recently deleted), filtered by text, author and team.

get.summary: Opens a notebook and records the visit (Recents). A deleted notebook still opens, to be restored.

delete.summary: Moves a notebook to Recently Deleted (restorable).

patch.summary: Saves changes (the editor autosaves). A deleted notebook must be restored first.

post.summary: A copy owned by the current user, titled "Clone of …".

put.summary: Stars or unstars a notebook for the current user (any role: it changes only their own list).

get.summary: The org's most recent notification deliveries.

post.summary: The signed-in member's shifts across every schedule (Summary → My Shifts, calendar export).
Pages another team or policy: back to triggered, from the first step.
Sends a test page notification to the member's high-urgency channels.
Shifts of an unsaved schedule (the editor's timeline).
The layers' shifts and the final schedule of a saved schedule over a range (≤ 93 days).

put.summary: Which escalation policy the team's pages follow.

patch.summary: Span and metric retention apply to data received from then on (within about a minute).

post.summary: Runs the action now with the given inputs, as the signed-in user.

get.summary: The org's app shortcuts.

post.summary:
Every entity of the catalog: services, datastores, queues, endpoints and external providers seen
in telemetry over the range, merged with the org's definitions, service metadata and repositories.

get.summary: Every provider's connector status; credentials are never returned.

put.summary: Configures a provider (admins). The token is sealed at rest; leave it out to keep the stored one.

delete.summary: Removes a provider's connector and its stored credential (admins).

post.summary: Checks the stored credential against the provider and records the outcome (admins).

get.summary: The org's entity definitions.

post.summary: Creates or replaces the definition of an entity (by kind and name), apiVersion v3.

Imports entity definition documents (YAML or JSON, apiVersion v3): all are validated first, then
each creates or replaces the definition of its kind and name.

put.summary: Replaces a definition; its kind and name may change when no other definition has them.

delete.summary: Deletes a definition; telemetry entities stay in the catalog, and a service keeps its metadata.

put.summary: Stars an entity for the current member.

get.summary: Services with their monitors, open issues, dashboards, scorecard level and on-call schedule.
The member's pull requests on GitHub or GitLab, grouped (cached for a minute).
The member's open Jira or Linear tickets, or the incidents they work on (`work_items`).
The current member's identity on each provider.

put.summary: Sets the current member's identities; an empty handle goes back to the default.

get.summary: Custom Reports: the dashboards added to the Reports tab, in order.

put.summary: Replaces the dashboards of Custom Reports (the org's own, not deleted).

post.summary: Scorecards Performance: the mean scorecard level of each team's services per day.

Teams Performance: incidents per team over time, mean time to resolve, and each team's services,
SLOs, monitors and On-Call schedules.

get.summary: Which telemetry signals feed the catalog (last 24 hours) and the external source connectors.
The survey as its respondents see it.
Every response, newest first, for the CSV export. Anonymous surveys name no one and list no teams.

post.summary: Records the signed-in member's response; each member responds once.
The matching profiles over the range, merged into one flame graph.
Patterns detected in the profiles of the range (Profiles → Insights), with their review state.
Marks an insight reviewed, resolved, ignored or back for review.
Explorer: the metric over time per service, each service's total and the facets.
Profiles in the range, newest first (Profile List).

get.summary:
The read-only page at `/status/<slug>`, without sign-in. Public pages answer to anyone; internal
pages only to signed-in members of the page's org. Everyone else gets 404, as for an unknown slug.

post.summary: Execute a dashboard in one request, preserving a separate result/error for every query ID.

A single POST SSE stream sends a full snapshot then aligned bucket replacements every 10s.
Identical subscriptions within the same organization share the plan, scans and retained history.
How individual series' values spread over time (heatmaps, distributions).
One value per `by` group, largest first (top lists, tables, pies, treemaps).
The query reduced to one number (groups combined per timestamp with the space aggregator first).
Timeseries for one or more queries; one series per `by` group.
Creates a table from an uploaded file.

get.summary: The table and a page of its rows (in file order), optionally searched.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text the primary key or a value contains.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: Search only this column (default: every column).

put.summary: Replaces every row with those of a new file, which must have the table's primary key column.

get.summary: Scorecards, rules, the last outcomes and every service's levels; `setUp` is false before setup.

post.summary: Reads telemetry again and evaluates every rule now.
Creates a custom rule (its outcomes come from `POST /api/v1/scorecards/rules/{id}/outcomes`).

put.summary: Changes a rule: level, scope and enabled for built-in rules, also name and description for custom ones.

delete.summary: Deletes a custom rule and its outcomes (built-in rules are disabled instead).

post.summary:
Reports outcomes of a custom rule per service (pass, fail or skip, with remarks); replaces
earlier outcomes of the same services.

put.summary: Sets a service's team, contacts, code repository and docs (rules read them on the next evaluation, which runs at once).

post.summary: Creates the recommended scorecards with the chosen built-in rules enabled, and evaluates them.

get.summary: The org's corrections, newest first (at most 1,000).

parameters.name: sloId
parameters.description: Only this SLO's corrections and the org-wide ones.

put.summary:
Replaces the page's fields and components. Components sent with the id of an existing one keep
it (and its notice history); the others get new ids.

post.summary: Opens a notice with its first update.

delete.summary: Deletes a notice posted by mistake, with its updates; it no longer counts in the uptime bars.

post.summary: Posts an update to an open notice; `resolved` resolves it.
Creates a test and its monitor; it first runs within seconds.
The org's tests, worst state first, with their uptime over the range.

put.summary: Replaces a test's definition (and updates its monitor). A changed request or assertions run soon.

delete.summary: Deletes a test with its results and its monitor.

post.summary: A test's runs, alert state and uptime over a range.
Runs a saved test now, once. The result is recorded; the alert state isn't changed.
Sends a request once from the editor (nothing is stored) and suggests assertions for its response.

get.summary: Values seen for a tag in the last day, across metrics and spans (template variable pickers).

post.summary: Creates a team with the current user as its admin.
Creates pending users and returns their invitation links.
One-time link (24h) that lets the user set a new password — for invites that expired or forgotten passwords.
Publishes the saved draft: triggers run it from now on, as the signed-in member.
Runs the saved draft now, as the signed-in member. The run executes in the background.
Creates a new API trigger token (the previous one stops working). It is shown once.

Starts the published workflow from a script: an application key authenticates the call and the
workflow's token (`X-Workflow-Token`) proves it may start this one.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up.
Readiness: every dependency answers. 503 when any is down.

ActionHttpRequest.description: One outbound request; its response must be 2xx for the run to go on.

body.description: JSON template sent as `application/json`; empty for no body.

method.description: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE.

url.description: Template; scheme and host are literal.

ActionInput.description: A field of the action's form.

fields.description: Internal steps: a template per field.

total.description: The measure over the whole range.

values.description: One value per bucket (null when the bucket has no spans).

query.description: Optional span search (`service:x status:error @db.system:redis`).

AppComponent.description: A component of an app; the fields used depend on its kind.

aggregation.description: Metric: avg, sum, min, max or last.

columns.description: Table: columns (keys of the list's items); all when empty.

inputs.description: Button: a template per workflow input key (`{{ components.env.value }}`).

path.description: Table: path of the list in the run's data (`Steps.top.output.groups`).

query.description: Metric: the metric query.

source.description: Table: the button whose latest run it shows.

width.description: Columns of the 12-column grid it spans (3, 4, 6, 8 or 12).

actors.description: Events per actor, ignoring the actor filter.

categories.description: Events per action category, ignoring the category filter.

oidcClientSecret.description: Replaces the stored secret when present; omit to keep it.

samlIdpMetadata.description: IdP federation metadata XML (Entra: "Federation Metadata XML").

samlIdpMetadataUrl.description: Alternatively, an https URL the server fetches the metadata from (Entra: "App Federation Metadata Url").

values.description: The app's input values, by component id.

BudgetUnit.description: What the error budget is counted in.

BurnLevel.description: How fast the error budget burns over the last hour.

CatalogCategory.description: Broad groups of resource types (the catalog's default grouping).

CatalogGroup.description: One group of a grouped search, with the distinct regions, envs, teams and services of its members.

groups.description: When grouped: every group of the matching resources, largest first.

attributes.description: Type-specific properties for the side panel (OS, node, images, owner, …).

id.description: `host:<name>` for hosts, the Kubernetes Explorer uid otherwise.

oneOf.description: Kubernetes Explorer kind, to open the resource there (null for hosts).

tags.description: `key:value` tags, as on the resource's own page.

groupBy.description: Group the results by a key (`resource_category`, `resource_type`, `region`, `env`, a tag key, …).

query.description: `resource_type:kube_pod env:prod cluster:shop-* team:payments` + free text on the name.

range.description: Hosts are those that reported in this range; Kubernetes and ECS resources are current.

sort.description: name (default), type, cluster, region or last_seen.

CatalogType.description: The resource types of the catalog.

oneOf.description: The Kubernetes Explorer kind and uid of the changed object, to open it there.

previous.description: Before and after (images, replicas, versions), when the change has them.

ChangeBucket.description: Changes in one time bucket, by change type.

query.description: `change_type:rollout service:order-service env:prod cluster:shop-*` + free text.

duration.description: Average duration (ms) per bucket; null when no execution.

series.description: One series per pipeline (job level: per job), the 8 busiest; the rest are merged into "other".

name.description: Pipeline name (pipeline level) or job name (job level).

previous.description: The same figures for the preceding period of equal length.

slowest.description: Pipelines with the highest p95 duration.

topFailing.description: Pipelines (name + repository) with the most failures.

query.description:
Words match pipeline/job names and repositories; `key:value` terms filter on status,
pipeline, repository (repo), branch, provider, team, sha, job, stage or author.

count.description: Resources under the group, folded ones included.

health.description: Worst health of the group's resources.

value.description: The value (`eu-west-1`); "" when the resources have none; `__other__` for merged small groups.

CloudMapNode.description: One block of the diagram: a resource, or `aggregate` resources folded into one.

aggregate.description: How many resources this block stands for when folded ("+N"); null for one resource.

alerts.description: Monitors alerting (or warning) on the resource; health overlay only.

errorRate.description: APM error rate of the resource's service over the last hour (0–1); health overlay only.

oneOf.description: The catalog row, for the side panel (null for folded blocks).

CloudMapProviderSummary.description: A provider tab with how many resources it has and, for hosts, their clouds.

groupBy.description: Group keys, outermost first; empty for the provider's default.

query.description: Catalog search narrowing the resources (`env:prod team:checkout`, free text on names).

backfillDays.description: Also archive the logs of the last N days still held in the raw table (0–2 by default, see OC_RAW_LOGS_HOURS).

query.description: Which logs to archive (search syntax); empty = all.

cells.description: The first cells (e.g. from a template).

adminEmail.description: Becomes the org's first Admin (invited; an existing account joins with its current password).

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes (2–40); used in URLs and SSO endpoints.

inviteUrl.description: One-time link (72h) for the first admin. Share it until mail delivery is configured.

widgets.description: Widget documents (schema owned by the web app).

starred.description: Per-user; doesn't change the dashboard's modified time.

data_scans.description: Actual telemetry SELECTs, excluding metadata discovery; independent of panel count.

kind.description: gauge | counter | delta | updown | histogram | exponential_histogram | summary | span | unknown

replace_from.description: Replace existing points at or after this aligned timestamp (also removes vanished series).

popularity.description: 0..5, from how often the dashboard is opened.

avgDurationMs.description: Average duration of the runs in the range (Airflow).

name.description: The DAG id or Spark application name.

running.description: Spark jobs running at the last check.

succeeded.description: Successful runs (Airflow DAG runs, Spark jobs) in the range.

databases.description: Databases its series are tagged with.

throughput.description: Transactions (PostgreSQL), queries (MySQL), commands (Redis), operations (MongoDB) or batches (SQL Server) per second.

oneOf.description: Null when the instance didn't report in the range.

enabled.description: False when no database integration metrics arrived in the range (show the setup guide).

unconfigured.description: Database servers seen running on hosts (process metrics) whose engine sends no integration metrics.

query.description: `engine:postgres env:prod cluster:x host:y service:z` + free text on the instance and its databases.

technology.description: `db.system` / `messaging.system` of an inferred one (postgresql, redis, kafka, …).

loginUrl.description: Where to send the browser; absent when no organization offers SSO.

otherErrors.description: Error codes other than SERVFAIL and NXDOMAIN.

requests.description: Requests: responses of every kind plus timeouts.

responseTimeUs.description: Mean response time of answered requests, microseconds.

errors.description: SERVFAIL, NXDOMAIN and other error codes.

clientGroupBy.description: Tag the clients (making DNS requests) are grouped by.

query.description: `client_service:checkout server_dns_query:*.example.net`, plus free text on the names.

serverGroupBy.description:
How DNS servers are shown: dns_server (pod or task, else host, else IP), host, service, ip
or dns_query (the domain queried).

showUnresolved.description: Clients without a value for their group-by tag (`N/A`).

changeFailureRate.description: Share of deployments that failed or caused an incident.

ratings.description: elite | high | medium | low per metric (DORA research thresholds).

timeToRestoreMs.description: Median time to resolve incidents affecting these services.

end.description: Epoch ms; absent = until canceled (not allowed for recurring downtimes).

monitorTags.description: …every monitor carrying all of these tags (empty = all monitors).

activeUntil.description: While active: when the current occurrence ends (absent = no end).

monitorTags.description: Monitors carrying all of these tags (when not targeting one monitor; empty = all monitors).

query.description: Matches monitor name, message, scope and monitor tags.

kind.description: service | datastore | queue | api | system | frontend

name.description: Unique per kind; stored in lower case.

tags.description: `key:value` tags.

componentOf.description: Systems this entity belongs to (`system:name`; a bare name is a system).

dependsOn.description: `kind:name` references (a bare name is a service).

lifecycle.description: production | experimental | deprecated, or the org's own words.

ErrorBody.description: JSON error body returned by every endpoint.

id.description: Stable within a search (timestamp, host and title hash).

EventBucket.description: Event counts in one time bucket, by status (error, warning, info, success).

key.description: `source`, `status`, `priority`, `host`, or a tag key (`env`, `service`, added ones).

extra.description: Tag keys added as facets ("+ Add"), after env and service.

query.description: Logs matching this search are excluded…

dbSystem.description: `db.system` of client database spans (mongodb, postgresql, redis, …).

environments.description: One per environment of the org, in environment order.

action.description: created, updated, deleted, enabled, disabled, targeting, rollout

environmentName.description: Empty for changes to the flag itself.

version.description: The flag's version after the change.

updatedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds; absent while never configured.

version.description: The flag version the change was made from.

apiKeys.description: API keys whose evaluations use this environment when the context names none.

queries.description: The `env` values SDKs send that select this environment (`production`, `staging-*`).

apiKeyIds.description: Ingest key ids defaulting to this environment; absent leaves them unchanged (admins only).

key.description: Used in code; can't be changed once created.

version.description: For updates: the version the change was made from.

attribute.description: A context attribute: `targetingKey`, `country`, or a dotted path into an object (`user.plan`).

FlagEnvConfig.description: A flag's configuration in one environment.

defaultServe.description: Served when no rule matches (and the rollout doesn't take the subject).

FlagOperator.description: How a condition compares the context attribute with its values.

FlagRollout.description: A progressive rollout: the traffic no rule matched moves to `variant` step by step.

startedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds the first step began (set by the server when the rollout starts).

durationMinutes.description: How long the step lasts before the next one starts (the last step lasts until changed).

percent.description: Percent of the remaining traffic that gets the rollout's variant during this step.

conditions.description: All must hold; none matches every subject.

FlagServe.description: What a rule (or the default) serves: one variant, or a split between variants.

FlagSplit.description: One part of a percentage split.

FlagType.description: The type of a flag's values.

FlagVariant.description: One value a flag can serve; `key` is the variant OpenFeature reports.

counts.description: Per state, ignoring the state filter.

flakyCommits.description: Commits on which the test both passed and failed.

cards.description: One card per sample type: its per-minute value or average.

functions.description: Self value per function, largest first.

scale.description:
Multiply a frame's value by this for Datadog's "Average …, per minute" (summed types) or
"Average …" (gauges).

endpoint.description: Only samples taken in this endpoint ("" = samples outside any endpoint); absent = all.

query.description: Filters: `service:x env:prod version:1.2 host:h`.

runtimeId.description: Restrict to one profiler process (a profile's runtime id), or all of the service's.

sampleType.description: Sample type (cpu-time, wall-time, alloc-space, …); default: CPU time, else the first one.

file.description: Source file, when the profiler reports one.

client.description: The client's value of the client group-by tag, or `N/A`.

clientTags.description: Tags every connection of the flow shares, per side (`key:value`).

established.description: TCP connections opened / closed in the range.

external.description: Whether the server is a public address.

rttUs.description: Mean round-trip time and its variance (jitter), microseconds (TCP).

throughputSent.description: Bytes per second over the range.

enabled.description: Whether any connection data exists (system-probe enabled somewhere).

series.description: Totals of the matching traffic over time (the summary graphs).

clientGroupBy.description:
Tag the clients are grouped by: service, env, availability-zone, kube_namespace, pod_name,
kube_service, host, container_name, short_image, ip, port, domain.

query.description:
`client_service:checkout server_env:prod -server_port:53`, plus free text matched against
the client and server names.

showUnresolved.description: Traffic whose client or server has no value for the group-by tag (`N/A`).

workloads.description: `namespace/pod` (or container) of the workloads its metrics are tagged with.

enabled.description: False when no GPU metrics arrived at all in the range (show the setup guide).

query.description: `cluster:x host:y model:z state:idle kube_namespace:n` + free text on the device, model and workloads.

StandardAttributeInput.description: A standard attribute as an org defines it.

aliases.description: Attribute paths whose value is copied to `path` when a log lacks it; the first one present wins.

preserveSource.description: Keep the alias attribute after copying its value (default); otherwise it is moved.

createdAt.description: When the component was added (epoch ms), if known: days before it have no uptime data.

currentStatus.description: The worst of `status` and the impacts of the open notices.

status.description: The status set on the page.

group.description: Components with the same group are shown together under it.

id.description: The id of an existing component to keep (and its notice history); omit for a new one.

emailSubscriptions.description: The page offers to subscribe to its updates by email / in Slack.

logoUrl.description: Shown in the page's header instead of its name; empty for none.

notices.description: Open notices and those resolved in the last 60 days, newest first.

emailSubscriptions.description: Show a subscribe button offering email / Slack updates (subscriptions aren't delivered yet).

logoUrl.description: An http(s) image URL shown in the header instead of the name; empty for none.

slug.description: 1–64 lowercase letters, digits and dashes (not first or last); unique across the instance.

impacts.description: The impacts of the latest update.

status.description: The status of the latest update.

updates.description: Newest first; the last one opened the notice.

StatusPageVisualization.description: How the page shows its components.

inAudience.description: The signed-in user is in the audience.

audienceTeams.description: Team handles asked; empty for every member.

notify.description: Notified of each response: channel handles (`slack-devex`, `webhook-portal`) or member emails.

template.description: Template the survey started from; empty for a custom survey.

id.description: Stable key of the question within the survey (`[a-z0-9_-]`).

counts.description: Likert labels, 0–10 for NPS, or the options; empty for text.

answers.description:
Answer per question id: 1–5 (Likert), 0–10 (NPS), an option (single choice), options (multiple
choice) or text.

SurveyResponseRow.description: One response, for the export. Anonymous surveys never name the respondent.

responseRate.description: Percent of the audience who responded.

SurveyState.description:
Whether a survey accepts responses now: an open survey before its open date is scheduled, after
its close date closed.

SurveyStatus.description: What the author sets: draft, open (accepting responses between the dates) or closed.

property.description: Header name, JSON path or DNS record type; empty for the other types.

target.description: The expected value (a number for status codes, times and days; a regular expression for matches).

actual.description: The value found (absent when there was none).

trusted.description: The chain verified against the public web roots for the host name.

privateTargets.description: The operator allows tests of loopback, private and link-local addresses (`OC_SYNTHETICS_ALLOW_PRIVATE`).

SyntheticRequest.description:
What a test sends. HTTP tests use `method`, `url`, `headers`, `body`, `basicAuth` and
`followRedirects`; SSL, DNS and TCP tests use `host` and `port`; DNS tests may name a server.

acceptSelfSigned.description: HTTP(S) and SSL: accept self-signed and otherwise untrusted certificates.

bodyType.description: Content type sent with a body (`application/json`, `text/plain`, …).

dnsServer.description: DNS: IP address of the server to ask; empty for the ObserveCraft server's resolver.

host.description: SSL, TCP: host name or IP address; DNS: the domain to look up.

method.description: HTTP: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD or OPTIONS.

url.description: HTTP: an http or https URL.

segments.description: The test's alert state over the range.

count.description: Retries of a failed run before it counts as failed (0–3).

SyntheticRunDetail.description: One run of a test, as stored with its result.

body.description: The start of the body (up to 64 KiB); kept with failed runs and runs started by hand.

bodyTruncated.description: The body was larger than the 1 MiB read.

durationMs.description: Response time in milliseconds: the whole HTTP exchange, the TLS handshake, the DNS lookups or the TCP connect.

error.description: Why the run failed before its assertions could be checked (timeout, refused address, …).

domain.description: The host the test reaches (from the URL for HTTP tests).

failingSince.description: First failed scheduled run of the current failure streak.

muted.description: A downtime silences the test's notifications now.

status.description: The alert state of the test's monitor.

uptime.description: Percent of the requested time range the test was OK (absent without a state in it).

locations.description: Location ids; empty for the ObserveCraft server.

message.description: Notification message of the test's monitor (`{{#is_alert}}…{{/is_alert}}`, `@handles`).

minFailureDurationMinutes.description: Alert once the test has failed for this many minutes (0: on the first failed run).

minLocationFailed.description: … from at least this many locations.

query.description: Words match name, domain and tags; `type:`, `env:`, `team:` and `status:` (ok, alert, nodata, paused) filter; other `key:value` words match tags.

range.description: The uptime is computed over this range.

suggestedAssertions.description: Assertions matching this response, to start the test from.

lastActiveAt.description: Last timeline entry they wrote on this incident.

member.description: Only teams this user (id, or "me") belongs to.

query.description: Matches name, handle or description.

prefix.description: Tag key the variable filters on.

message.description: The rendered message; its `@handles` are the recipients.

monitorId.description: Monitor (for its link, name, tags); absent while creating one.

criticalRecovery.description: While in Alert, the group recovers only once the value no longer crosses this.

kind.description: declared | note | status | severity | commander | notification | impact | followup

points.description: Rough number of points wanted per series (default 120).

queries.description: Queries with template variables already resolved by the client.

start.description: Epoch ms of the earliest span.

startUs.description: Offset from the trace start, microseconds.

statuses.description: alert | warn | nodata (OK groups are never listed).

triggeredWithin.description: Only groups that changed state within this many minutes.

query.description: Matches name or email.

WorkItem.description: Correlated events: one affected object's warnings and errors.

reason.description: The newest event's reason (`BackOff`, `OOMKilling`), when it names one.

state.description: open (events in the last 30 minutes of the range) | closed

tags.description: Where it happened (cluster, namespace, service, env).

oneOf.description: What triggers run; none until published.

secretNames.description: Names of the stored credentials (values are never returned).

unpublishedChanges.description: The draft differs from the published version.

handle.description: Mentioned as `@workflow-<handle>`; made from the name when empty at creation, kept otherwise.

secrets.description: Credentials by name: a value sets one, null removes it, names left out keep their value.

oneOf.description: Detail only: the spec it ran.

status.description: queued | running | waiting | succeeded | failed | canceled

steps.description: Detail only: what each step did, in order.

triggerKind.description: manual | monitor | schedule | incident | api | app

iteration.description: The "for each" item it ran for, when inside one.

WorkflowSpec.description: What a workflow does: its form, triggers and steps.

continueOnError.description: Action steps: a failure is recorded and the run goes on.

expression.description: If: the condition. For each: the list.

fields.description: Action steps: a template per field.

id.description: `[a-z0-9_]`, unique in the workflow; others read its result as `Steps.<id>`.

name.description: Shown on the canvas; the kind's name when empty.

retries.description: Action steps: attempts after a failure (0–3), 5 s apart.

steps.description: If: run when the condition holds. For each: run per item.

incidentEvents.description: Incident: declared, updated, resolved; all when empty.

severities.description: Incident: severities that start a run; any when empty.

timezone.description: Schedule: IANA time zone; UTC when empty.

transitions.description: Monitor: the states that start a run (alert, warn, nodata, ok); alert when empty.
